result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both answers give working code and remove the clutter. A explains better why each removed effect was not pulling its weight, and it catches that the icon is a lantern, not pottery. However, A makes the price (22px) larger than the title (20px), which undercuts rubric item 4. B ranks title over price over meta correctly and demotes the secondary buttons in steps (outline, then text link). B has its own flaws: it wrongly says the icon is 🏺 when the code still shows the lantern, and it shortens 'Add to wishlist' to 'Wishlist'. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers deliver working code with a single clear primary button and much less decoration. B gives the better account of why the card looked busy. It also correctly spots that 🏮 is a lantern (🏮), not pottery, and fixes real contrast problems. A calls that same icon 🏺 when it isn't. B's main weakness is making the price (22px) larger than the title (20px), which works against the title being the top text level. A also demotes the secondary actions a bit more clearly, using an outline button and a text link.
